reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: A five-year GEL denominated senior unsecured loan in amount of USD 20 mln provided to Bank of Georgia ("BoG"), one of the largest systemic banks operating in Georgia. The project will further promote the Eastern Partnership SME Competitiveness ("EaP SMEC") Programme, a successor to the DCFTA Programme, in which BoG has actively participated since 2016. The proceeds of the Bank's investment will be on-lent by the bank in line with EaP SMEC Programme' Policy Statement to private sector sub-borrowers (MSMEs) to upgrade their technologies and equipment up to EU standards, including for investments in sustainable technologies and promotion of the use of green technologies, enhancing MSMEs' competitiveness. At least 70% of the loan is expected to be GET-eligible, in line with the EaP SMEC programme terms.
